interface.longDescription: Release v0.28.0: three opt-in memory reliability tools. Paired memory formation controls separate clean task success, final and intermediate contamination, and later failures in synthetic workflows. Current-value assembly extracts selected ledger rows and applies separately host-authorized source, scope and validity policies, abstaining on conflicts or missing metadata. Read-only procedural recall binds source steps and a dependency DAG to current completed native receipts under exact reuse conditions. Outputs require review; receipt binding does not prove procedure execution. Synthetic controls are not model robustness results. Existing memory, improvement experiments, 15 slash commands, Jarvis API authentication and v0.26.0 upgrade requirements remain. No automatic execution, promotion, default hook/search change, model/network call, new runtime dependency or automatic vault migration.
